environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on an ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (subnet-0f4e3d2c1b0a9) within VPC vpc-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a3. The subnet route table (rtb-0deadbeef1234) has NO route to a NAT Gateway or Internet Gateway — only local VPC routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for ECR/CloudWatch (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f6). MongoDB Atlas is accessed via AWS PrivateLink endpoint (vpce-0mongo7654321) with no public endpoint. The ECS task security group (sg-0locked999) allows egress ONLY to the MongoDB PrivateLink ENI (10.0.47.12/32:27017) and the VPC endpoint prefix list for AWS services (pl-63a5400a). DNS resolution is handled by Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. There is no NAT instance, no proxy, no VPC peering to any subnet with internet access, and no Transit Gateway attachment.
